actions.text: Remove or repoint the `uat-pricing.acme.internal` reference in production

findings.audience: Everyone who depends on the production estate
findings.lead: A production service that calls a test or UAT host is a configuration error waiting to become an incident: the host can be rebuilt, reset or switched off without notice, and its data is not production data. `uat-pricing.acme.internal` was called 603,000 times from `catalog-api` in the Services-list export, about 6 days (p95 250 ms).

actions.text: Pull one day of `POST /pay/authorise` failures from the application log and classify them (validation, data, timeout, dependency)
Alert when `POST /pay/authorise` fails more than 380 times in an hour (about 2.0× the hourly average in the week to 19 Nov 2026, which is 186), and lower the threshold as the fix lands
Track card authorisations against the agreed 99.5 % success target as a Datadog SLO, so the burn rate pages before the target is missed

Cache the token in each client of `payment-gateway` until shortly before it expires — that removes at least 726,840 calls in the week to 19 Nov 2026 (the excess over one token per business call) and up to nearly all 1,105,404

bullets: **`POST /pay/authorise` fails 31,274 of 347,492 (9.00 %)** in the week to 19 Nov 2026 — about 4,468 a day. Each failure is a user or an operator who has to retry, or work that is not done.
**`POST /pay/refund` fails 10,254 of 31,072 (33.0 %)** — fewer calls, but the highest failure rate on the service: one in three calls fails.
The agreed target for card authorisations is 99.5 % success; in the week to 19 Nov 2026 it achieved 91.0 %.

1,105,404 calls to `POST /oauth/token` for 378,564 calls to `payment-gateway`'s other business operations in the week to 19 Nov 2026 is **2.92 per call**. Tokens are normally cached until they expire; requesting them per call multiplies the load on the token endpoint, and each token request takes up to 89 ms (p95) before the business call can start.
findings.lead: `payment-gateway` (part of Payments: card authorisation and refunds through the payment provider) handled 1.5 million business requests in the week to 19 Nov 2026 and failed 41,528 of 1,483,968 (2.80 %). They concentrate on two operations:

mom.label: failure rate of POST /pay/authorise
mom.then_title: One in twelve card authorisations fails on Payment gateway; refunds fail 45.0 %

summary.action: Root-cause the `POST /pay/authorise` failures; alert on regressions; cache tokens until expiry
summary.finding: **One in twelve card authorisations fails** on `payment-gateway` (31,274 of 347,492 in the week to 19 Nov 2026); refunds fail 33.0 %; clients request about 2.92 new tokens per business call
